Class Main

java.lang.Object
com.jme3.app.LegacyApplication
com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication
com.mygame.Main
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jme3.app.Application, com.jme3.system.SystemListener
public class Main extends com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication
Application entry point for the desktop OpenWorld demo.

Loads config.xml, configures the jMonkeyEngine window, and creates the world scene.
